requirements.requirement: remote_version represents the server-assigned version for the state actually represented by the local source of truth. Device clock, createdAt, updatedAt, occurredAt, and pending/estimated timestamps MUST NEVER become authoritative remote_version.

Mutation Correlation: Every local mutation capable of producing a server version MUST have a UUID mutationId/syncMutationId attached to local DB, Outbox, Firestore write, and server confirmation/reconciliation to distinguish local mutation ACK from remote mutations.

Mandatory Lifecycle: Successful batch.commit() marks Outbox SUCCEEDED but does NOT establish remote_version; state remains temporarily UNTRACKED / VERSION_CAPTURE_RETRY until server-confirmed read-back/snapshot confirms final timestamp.

Server-Confirmed Read-Back & Reconciliation: Use explicit server confirmation (Source.SERVER or confirmed metadata) for explicit reconciliation, missed confirmation recovery, startup repair, crash recovery, UNTRACKED repair, and VERSION_CAPTURE_RETRY.

Realtime Listener Pending Snapshot Contract: When hasPendingWrites == true, MUST NOT apply local echo as remote event, MUST NOT establish or advance remote_version, and MUST NOT use doc.data['updatedAt'] as server version.

Realtime Listener Confirmed Snapshot Contract: When hasPendingWrites == false, process event, capture final server timestamp, update remote_version only if version represents local state; if non-final or unavailable, remain UNTRACKED or VERSION_CAPTURE_RETRY.
isFromCache and Server Confirmation: Cache snapshots alone must never establish authoritative remote_version. Authoritative backend reads require server confirmation.

Separation of Push Success from Version Capture Failure: Push failure retries outbox; push success + capture failure marks Outbox succeeded, sets remote_version = UNTRACKED and version_capture = RETRY_REQUIRED, and FORBIDS re-enqueuing or replaying the mutation.

Version/State Divergence Protection (BLOCKING): A newer remote version B MUST NOT be saved as local remote_version unless/until state B is applied to local DB atomically (local state == state represented by remote_version).

Monotonicity: remote_version is monotonic (stale incoming < current ignored, equal incoming == current idempotent no-op, higher incoming > current accepted only with corresponding local state transition).
Delete / Tombstone Contract: Delete version must come from server-confirmed tombstone source, never derived from pre-delete local timestamps (updatedAt, createdAt, occurredAt, device clock).

Crash / Missed-Listener Recovery: On startup/recovery, inspect UNTRACKED / VERSION_CAPTURE_RETRY, reconcile with Source.SERVER, obtain authoritative state/version and apply atomically without re-sending outbox.

Required Behavioral Tests (Tests 1-16) in Phase2ServerConfirmedLifecycleTest.kt: pendingSnapshot (T1), confirmedState (T2), nonFinalTimestamp (T3), clockSkew (T4), pushSuccessCaptureFailure (T5), crashRecovery (T6), concurrentRemoteWriter (T7), mutationIdMismatch (T8), duplicateConfirmation (T9), outOfOrderConfirmation (T10), deleteTombstone (T11), offlineReconnect (T12), missedRealtimeConfirmation (T13), sourceServerUnavailable (T14), twoDeviceConvergence (T15), productionPathOracle (T16).

Phase 2 Adversarial / False-Pass Protection Fixture Phase2RemoteVersionAdversarialTest covering Case A (Pending Timestamp Injection), Case B (Cache Timestamp Promotion), Case C (Local Timestamp Promotion), Case D (Version Ahead of Local State), Case E (Mutation ID Mismatch), and Case F (Replay After Successful Push).
Phase 2 Adversarial Fixtures MUST be integrated into the Meta-Gate and executed on every certification run; any regression in detection ability must cause CERTIFICATION = FAIL.
